ns2:course.label: Advanced Topics in Literature & Cultural Studies
ns2:course.description: Selected topics in Spanish, Latin American and/or Latina/o literatures and cultural studies. Specific topics may vary. Instruction in Spanish unless otherwise noted. May be repeated in same or separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Two 300-level courses in Spanish/Latin American literature or cultural studies or consent of instructor.
